joinCodeInvalid: This join code is not valid.

contributionFailed: Could not save your change. Retry keeps totals safe.

noContributionsYet: No contributions yet. Set your quantities below.
onlyOwnerCanManage: Only the owner can manage sharing.

sharedBucketEditHint: Structure changes are visible to every member.
confirmDeleteSharedBucket: Delete this shared bucket for every member? Existing orders remain available.
passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters with a letter and a number.
loginIntro: Use your account to access your reusable food lists.
registerIntro: Create buckets once and reuse them for every order.
resetIntro: Enter your email and we will send recovery instructions.
passwordsDoNotMatch: The new password and its confirmation do not match.
passwordResetDone: Your password was reset. Log in with your new password.
resetLinkInvalidTitle: This reset link is not valid
resetLinkInvalidBody: The password-reset link is incomplete, has expired, or was already used.
ordersEmptyHint: Choose a bucket to create your first order.
confirmDeleteAccount: Delete your account and all owned buckets and orders permanently? Shared buckets you joined keep your past contributions in their totals.
requiresRecentLogin: Please log in again, then retry deleting your account.
notFoundBody: The requested page does not exist.
resetConfirmation: If an account exists for this email, a password-reset message will arrive. Check your spam folder too.
firebaseRequired: Password-reset email requires Firebase to be configured for this build.
noMatchingBuckets: No matching results in the loaded buckets.
noMatchingOrders: No matching orders in the loaded results.
confirmLogoutMessage: You will need to sign in again to access your buckets and orders.
deleteAccountReauthWarning: This permanently deletes your account and everything you own. Re-enter your email and password to continue. This cannot be undone.
notificationPromptMessage: Get a notification when someone opens an order round, invites you, or your order changes. You can change this any time in Settings.
tutorialsReset: Tutorials will show again on each page.
tourDashboardStatsBody: These tiles count your menus, orders, and everything still in progress. Tap one to jump straight there.
tourDashboardCreateBody: Create a menu once, then reuse it for every order round you run with the same people.
tourBucketsTemplateBody: A menu is a template. Editing it never touches orders you already placed.
tourBucketsRoundBody: Open a new round from a shared menu and everyone on it is invited automatically.
tourOrdersListBody: Search and filter past orders here, and open any one to repeat it.
tourSocialBody: Add friends and groups so a shared menu can reach them in one tap.
tourSettingsBody: Preferences, privacy, security, and your data each live on their own page.
tourBucketEditorItemsBody: List every dish once. You can edit or deactivate an item later without touching past orders.
tourBucketEditorPricingBody: VAT, service, and delivery are stored with the menu and applied to every order made from it.
tourCollaborateQuantitiesBody: Each member sets their quantities. The totals update as contributions arrive.
tourCollaboratePlaceBody: Freezing stops further changes, then one order captures everyone’s picks and split charges.
tourBucketShareCodeBody: Send this code and anyone can join the menu without an invitation email.
tourBucketShareRolesTitle: Roles control what people can do
tourBucketShareRolesBody: Viewers only look, contributors add their own quantities, editors can change the menu itself.
tourSocialShareBody: Send the menu straight to a friend or a whole group instead of copying a code.
tourOrderDetailsRepeatBody: Repeat copies this order as a fresh draft; a new round re-opens the menu for the same people.
tourOrderDetailsStatusBody: Place, complete, or cancel the order as it progresses. Completed and cancelled orders are final.
tourCreateOrderQuantitiesBody: Use plus and minus for each dish. Anything left at zero is simply not ordered.
tourCreateOrderTotalsBody: The summary shows the subtotal plus every charge before you place the order.
tourSessionsBody: Every order round you organise or take part in is collected here until it is settled.
tourSessionDetailsMenuBody: These items were copied from the template when the round opened, so later menu edits cannot change it.
tourSessionDetailsParticipantsBody: See at a glance who has ordered, who is still deciding, and who opted out.
tourCreateSessionDeadlineBody: An optional cut-off time tells everyone when their choices need to be in.
tourCreateSessionAutoLockBody: Auto-lock stops accepting changes at the deadline so you do not have to watch the clock.
tourSettingsPreferencesBody: Name, language, theme, and currency are saved to your account and follow you to any device.
tourSettingsSecurityBody: You need your current password, so a forgotten session cannot change it for you.
tourSettingsAccountExportBody: Export downloads everything you own as a single readable file.
tourSettingsAccountDangerBody: You will be asked for your email and password first, and nothing is removed until they match.
tourJoinBody: Paste the code someone shared and the menu appears under "Shared with me".
tourSettingsPrivacyBody: Choose a level and the app records only that. Everything stays on this device and you can erase it here.
tourDashboardWelcomeBody: This is the dashboard. Everything you run — menus, orders, and group rounds — starts from this screen.
tourDashboardSharedBody: When a friend shares a menu, it is counted here so you know how many groups you can order with.
tourDashboardProgressBody: Placed and completed counts tell you what is waiting on the restaurant and what is already finished.
tourDashboardNavBody: The sidebar holds menus, orders, rounds, friends, and settings. It collapses if you want more room.
tourBucketsIntroBody: Every menu you own or joined is listed here, newest first, so the one you order from most is easy to find.
tourBucketsMineBody: "My menus" are the ones you can edit. Shared menus belong to someone else — you order from them but the owner keeps control.
tourBucketsJoinBody: Got a code from a friend? "Join with code" adds their menu to your list without them adding you manually.
tourBucketsDeleteBody: Deleting your own menu removes it for everyone. Leaving a shared one only removes it from your list.
tourBucketEditorNameBody: Use the restaurant's name so the menu is obvious in a list months later. The description is a good place for delivery notes.
tourBucketEditorCategoryBody: A category keeps drinks apart from mains. It is optional, but long menus get much easier to scan with it.
tourBucketEditorCurrencyBody: Every price, fee, and split on this menu uses this currency, so pick it before you invite anyone.
tourBucketEditorActiveTitle: Hide what is off the menu
tourBucketEditorActiveBody: Switch an item off instead of deleting it. Past orders keep their history and the item comes back with one tap.
tourBucketEditorSaveBody: Your edits stay local until you save. Leaving the page without saving keeps the previous version intact.
tourBucketEditorSharedBody: If someone else owns this menu, only they can change the items. Ask them, or duplicate it to get your own copy.
tourBucketShareEnableTitle: Sharing is off until you turn it on
tourBucketShareEnableBody: A menu is private by default. Enable sharing when you are ready for other people to order from it.
tourBucketShareMembersBody: Everyone who joined is listed here. Removing someone revokes their access immediately, but keeps the orders they already placed.
tourBucketShareFreezeBody: Freezing stops new orders arriving while you call the restaurant, so the total you read out cannot change under you.
tourBucketShareActivityBody: The activity log records joins, orders, and freezes, so nobody has to scroll a chat to work out what happened.
tourCollaborateIntroBody: You are ordering from someone else's menu. You choose your own items; the owner collects everything and places the order.
tourCollaborateTotalsBody: The total shown is your share, with fees split fairly, not the whole group's bill.
tourCollaborateLiveBody: Other people's choices appear without a refresh, so you can see whether everyone has ordered yet.
tourCollaborateEtiquetteBody: Edit your order any time before the owner freezes the menu. After that, ask them directly.
tourSocialSharePickBody: Choose from your friends instead of sending a code. They get the menu straight away with no code to type.
tourSocialShareRoleBody: Give people ordering access, or let a co-organiser help you edit the menu and manage the round.
tourSocialShareOpenBody: Open the menu as they will see it. Only the items and prices are shared, never your other menus or orders.
tourSocialShareRevokeBody: Removing someone here cuts their access at once. Sharing is never permanent.
tourJoinCodeBody: The owner finds it on the menu's sharing screen. Codes are short on purpose so they are easy to read out loud.
tourJoinPreviewBody: The preview shows the menu name and its owner, so you can be sure you got the right code before joining.
tourJoinRoleBody: Your role decides whether you can only order or also help manage. The owner sets it and can change it later.
tourJoinSharedBody: Joined menus appear under "Shared with me" on the menus screen and stay there until you leave.
tourOrdersSearchBody: Search by menu name or by what you ordered. Handy when you want to repeat something from weeks ago.
tourOrdersStatusTitle: Filter by where it got to
tourOrdersStatusBody: Drafts are not sent yet, placed orders are with the restaurant, and completed ones are done and paid.
tourOrdersOpenBody: Tapping an order shows every item, the fee breakdown, and the notes you left with it.
tourOrdersDeleteBody: A deleted order cannot be restored, so it asks first. Group orders stay with the menu's history.
tourOrdersEmptyBody: Orders show up after you place your first one. Start from a menu and this list fills itself.
tourOrderDetailsItemsBody: Every item and quantity is recorded, so there is no arguing later about who asked for what.
tourOrderDetailsTotalsBody: Subtotal, VAT, service, and delivery are listed separately, so the final number is always explainable.
tourOrderDetailsNotesBody: Allergies, no onions, extra sauce — whatever you wrote stays attached to this order permanently.
tourOrderDetailsRevisionBody: The order keeps the prices from the day you placed it, so later menu edits never rewrite your history.
tourCreateOrderItemsBody: Only active items from the menu appear here, each with its saved price so nothing has to be typed again.
tourCreateOrderSubtotalBody: Every row shows its own subtotal, so an accidental extra portion is obvious before you place the order.
tourCreateOrderFeesBody: VAT, service, and delivery use the rules saved on the menu, so they are the same for everyone ordering from it.
tourCreateOrderNotesBody: Put special requests in the notes rather than a separate message — they stay with the order for good.
tourCreateOrderPlaceBody: Save a draft while you are still deciding. Placing it tells the organiser you are done and locks in your total.
tourSessionsActiveBody: Each card is one round of ordering from a menu. Open it to see who has joined and what they picked.
tourSessionsRefreshBody: Rounds update on their own, but refresh gives you an immediate read before you call the restaurant.
tourSessionsOpenBody: Inside a round you get the menu it uses, the participants, their choices, and the running total.
tourSessionsEmptyBody: Start one from any menu. Everyone already on that menu is invited automatically — no re-inviting each week.
tourSessionsOrganizerBody: This screen is the control room: you decide when a round opens, when it locks, and when it is settled.
tourSessionDetailsStatusBody: The status tells everyone whether choices are still open, locked for ordering, or already settled.
tourSessionDetailsTotalsBody: The running total covers everyone's choices plus fees, so you can read it straight to the restaurant.
tourSessionDetailsLockBody: Locking stops late changes so the total you order matches the total you collected. Nobody can quietly edit afterwards.
tourSessionDetailsRefreshBody: Refresh right before locking, so a choice sent seconds ago is not left out of the order.
tourSessionDetailsSettleBody: Per-person and per-item views show who owes what, so settling up does not need a calculator.
tourCreateSessionMenuBody: A round copies the menu's items and prices as they are now, so later edits cannot change an order already under way.
tourCreateSessionNameBody: Optional, but "Friday lunch" is far easier to recognise later than a date. Leave it blank and the menu's name is used.
tourCreateSessionTimezoneBody: The deadline is read in this timezone, so people in other cities see the right cut-off rather than yours.
tourCreateSessionOpenBody: The moment the round opens, everyone on the menu is notified and can start choosing.
tourSocialInviteBody: Send a request by email address. Once they accept, sharing a menu with them takes one tap instead of a code.
tourSocialRequestsBody: Incoming requests sit here until you accept or decline. Nobody becomes a friend without your agreement.
tourSocialGroupsBody: Put the people you always order with in a group, then share a menu with the whole group at once.
tourSocialShareBucketsBody: Friends are the shortcut for sharing menus — pick people you already know instead of passing codes around.
tourSocialRemoveBody: Removing someone does not delete shared menus. Revoke those on each menu's sharing screen if you want them gone too.
tourSettingsPreferencesCardBody: Your name, language, theme, currency, and notifications live here — everything about how the app looks and speaks to you.
tourSettingsPrivacyCardBody: Choose what the app is allowed to record, see exactly how much is stored, and erase it whenever you like.
tourSettingsSecurityCardBody: Change your password here. This is the only place that touches your sign-in credentials.
tourSettingsAccountCardBody: Export everything you have created, or close the account permanently. The irreversible actions are kept apart on purpose.
tourSettingsPreferencesProfileBody: Your name appears next to your choices in group rounds, so pick something the group will recognise.
tourSettingsPreferencesLanguageBody: The whole app, including Arabic Franco, switches instantly. Your choice follows you to any device you sign in on.
tourSettingsPreferencesThemeBody: Pick "system" and the app follows your phone or laptop, switching with it through the day.
tourSettingsPreferencesNotificationsBody: Turn these on and your device tells you when a round opens or an invitation arrives, even with the app closed.
tourSettingsPreferencesReplayBody: Dismissed a tour too fast? Replay makes every screen introduce itself again from the beginning.
tourSettingsPrivacyConsentBody: Diagnostics start switched off. Choose a level only if you want to help, and the app records nothing more than that level.
tourSettingsPrivacyStoredBody: This is the actual count of events held on this device — not a promise, the live figure.
tourSettingsPrivacyClearBody: Clearing wipes the stored events from this device immediately. There is no copy kept anywhere else.
tourSettingsPrivacyThirdPartyBody: Analytics and performance measurement only load if you allow them. Withdraw consent and they stop loading at all.
tourSettingsPrivacySaveBody: Save applies the level to this device and your profile, so it holds wherever you sign in next.
tourSettingsSecurityCurrentBody: Your current password is required first, so a borrowed unlocked phone cannot be used to lock you out.
tourSettingsSecurityNewBody: Length beats complexity. A few unrelated words are easier to remember and much harder to guess.
tourSettingsSecurityConfirmBody: The confirmation catches typos before they lock you out of your own account.
tourSettingsSecurityRevealBody: The eye reveals the password so you can check it. Use it only when nobody is reading over your shoulder.
tourSettingsAccountProfileBody: The email shown here is the one you sign in with and the one every invitation is tied to.
tourSettingsAccountReauthBody: You confirm the warning, then re-enter your email and password. Nothing is deleted until both match.
tourSettingsAccountIrreversibleBody: Deleting removes your menus, orders, and friendships for good. Export first if you want to keep a copy.
tourSettingsAccountAlternativeBody: Signing out or turning off notifications is enough for most people. Deletion is only for leaving permanently.
shareActivityHint: Who joined, ordered, and froze — in order.
tourSocialFriendsSearchBody: Search the exact address they signed up with. Nobody is listed publicly, so an address is the only way to find a person here.
tourSocialFriendsRequestBody: A request waits for their answer. You never appear in someone's friends list without them agreeing to it.
tourSocialFriendsListBody: Accepted friends collect here. This list is what the sharing screens read when you pick people by name.
tourSocialFriendsShortcutBody: With friends saved, sharing a menu is one tap instead of reading a code out loud to each person.
tourSocialFriendsRemoveBody: Unfriending is immediate and needs no approval, but it leaves shared menus alone — revoke those on each menu's sharing screen.
tourSocialRequestsIntroBody: Three kinds of invitation land here. Nothing on this page has happened yet — each one needs your answer first.
tourSocialRequestsFriendBody: Someone found you by email and asked to connect. Accepting adds you both to each other's list.
tourSocialRequestsGroupBody: Joining a group means menus shared with that group reach you too, without anyone inviting you one by one.
tourSocialRequestsMenuBody: Access to a shared menu only activates once you accept. Until then the owner sees your invitation as still pending.
tourSocialRequestsDeclineBody: Turning something down simply removes it from this page. The sender is told the outcome, not given a reason.
tourSocialGroupsWhyBody: A group is a named set of friends. Share a menu with the group and everyone in it gets access at once.
tourSocialGroupsCreateBody: "Friday lunch" or "the office" beats a list of names. The description is a good place for who belongs in it.
tourSocialGroupsInviteBody: Only accepted friends can be invited, and each invitation waits for its own answer before that person counts as a member.
tourSocialGroupsMembersBody: Removing someone takes away access that came through this group, but access you granted them directly stays untouched.
tourSocialGroupsLeaveBody: Leaving removes only you. Deleting ends the group for everyone, so only its owner can do it.
tourShareMembersRolesBody: A viewer reads the menu, a contributor orders from it, and a co-organiser helps you run it. Start people low and raise them.
tourShareMembersPermissionsTitle: Finer control when you need it
tourShareMembersPermissionsBody: Custom permissions adjust one person without changing their role, for the case a role almost fits but not quite.
tourShareMembersChangeBody: A new role takes effect immediately, including for someone with the menu already open. There is no save step to forget.
tourShareMembersRemoveBody: Removal cuts them off straight away and asks first, because it is not something you want to do by mis-tap.
tourShareMembersHistoryBody: Orders someone already placed stay in the menu's history. Removing a person never rewrites a total you have collected.
tourShareActivityLogBody: Every join, order, and freeze is written here in order, so working out what happened never means scrolling a conversation.
tourShareActivityOrderBody: Order entries carry the person and the moment, which is usually enough to settle "I did add mine" on the spot.
tourShareActivityFreezeBody: The log shows exactly when ordering closed, so a choice that arrived afterwards is visibly late rather than disputed.
tourShareActivityTrustBody: Entries are written by the app as things happen. They cannot be added, changed, or removed by hand.
